ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (30) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Бог» (bog, 'God') is capitalized as 'God', but Tolstoy's lowercase pronouns for God are kept ('in him', 'out of him'), and in «нет другого бога, кроме бога» (net drugogo boga, krome boga) the first is a common noun: 'no other god but God'. Mazzini's «бесконечное совершенствование» (beskonechnoye sovershenstvovaniye) is 'infinite perfecting'; attributions follow the print, «Анфантен» (Anfanten) as 'Enfantin', with no first name added.
